_readme: The GitHub chapter on the home page (03.1). `username` drives every live request. `featured` is the exhibition list, in order: `repo` must be the exact repository name; name/category/description/technologies are yours to write; stars, language and last update come from GitHub at build time and refresh from /api/github. Leave `technologies` empty to show GitHub's primary language instead. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in Vercel (a fine-grained token with no permissions is enough) for exact contribution counts via GraphQL and a higher rate limit; without it the calendar is read from your public profile. `plate` picks the drawn engineering plate shown on hover: rag, inference, agents, evaluation, ai-systems or ml-infra.

featured.name: Aperture RAG
featured.description: A local-first retrieval system built around one constraint: if the evidence is weak, the answer should not pretend otherwise.

featured.name: Shared-Prefix Benchmark
featured.description: Measures what KV-cache reuse does to prefill, time to first token and throughput for a local qwen2.5:7b on Ollama.

featured.name: Automated LLM Testing
featured.description: A CI pipeline that evaluates LLM applications for hallucinations, harmful outputs and data drift before they ship.

featured.name: CyberSentinel SOC
featured.description: A security-operations platform that explains its predictions with feature importance, SHAP local explanations and plain-language summaries.

featured.name: Collaborative Filtering
featured.description: User–user collaborative filtering on an IMDB movie dataset, served as an interactive Streamlit recommender.
